review_notes.policy: Retain substantive user requirements. Existing scoring does not prove they are satisfied; these dimensions require a separate rubric, not word deletion or invented thresholds.
remaining_ambiguities: Reviewed food options are finite authoring choices, not a claim of exhaustive natural-language equivalence.
Degenerate ordinary snack portions and unscored qualitative requests other than high-protein still need a separate rubric.
retracted_findings: Only the default now timestamp acts as a wildcard; the revised questions explicitly name lunch.
Recipe quantities are now explicitly measured before cooking to distinguish raw from cooked entries.
